lists.content:
At Insomnia Cookies, warm cookies are just the beginning.

As a Cookie Crew Member, you're part baker, part hospitality expert, and part late-night hero. Whether you're welcoming guests into the bakery, pulling a fresh tray of cookies from the oven, or packing the perfect delivery order, you'll help create the experience that keeps our fans coming back night after night.

Our bakeries move fast, especially after the rest of the world has called it a night. Every shift is a team effort, and every warm cookie, friendly interaction, and perfectly packed order matters.

If you enjoy working with great people, thrive in an energetic environment, and love making someone's day just a little sweeter, you'll fit right in.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

Every shift is a little different, but you can expect to:

  • Welcome every guest with genuine hospitality and make every interaction memorable.
  • Prepare, bake, and package our warm cookies, brownies, ice cream, and other treats to Insomnia's quality standards.
  • Accurately prepare in-store, pickup, delivery, and online orders.
  • Operate the register and process guest transactions.
  • Keep the bakery clean, stocked, organized, and food-safe throughout every shift.
  • Jump in wherever your team needs you, whether that's restocking supplies, helping a teammate, or keeping the line moving.
  • Resolve guest concerns with empathy and urgency, partnering with your Shift Leader when needed.
  • Deliver the kind of experience that turns first-time guests into lifelong Insomniacs.

QUALIFICATIONS
  • Must be 18 years of age or older
  • Ability to obtain any required food safety certifications applicable to the location
  • Ability to perform the essential functions of the position with or without reasonable accommodation.

    • Physical Requirements

    This position regularly requires the ability to:

  • Stand and walk for extended periods of time (up to 8 hours per shift).
  • Frequently reach, bend, stoop, twist, kneel, and lift.
  • Lift, carry, push, and pull up to 30 pounds regularly.
  • Occasionally lift up to 50 pounds with assistance.
  • Use hands and fingers to handle bakery equipment, food products, and a point-of-sale system.
  • Work in environments with varying temperatures, including around ovens, freezers, and refrigeration units.
  • Safely operate kitchen equipment in accordance with company procedures.
  • Read order screens, recipes, and safety information.
  • Communicate effectively with guests and team members in a fast-paced environment.

    • Work Environment

    This position works in a fast-paced bakery environment that includes frequent interaction with guests, exposure to heat from ovens, refrigerated storage areas, cleaning chemicals, and moderate noise levels. Evening, late-night, weekend, and holiday shifts are a regular part of the business.

    Schedule Expectations

    Our bakeries are busiest during evenings, late nights, weekends, and holidays. Team Members should have availability during these peak business hours. Scheduling needs vary by location.

lists.content:
At Insomnia Cookies, warm cookies are just the beginning.

As a Cookie Crew Delivery Driver, you'll deliver more than cookies—you'll deliver the moments people remember. Whether it's a late-night study break, birthday surprise, office celebration, or just someone's well-deserved treat, you'll be the friendly face bringing a little happiness right to their door.

When you're not out making deliveries, you'll be part of the bakery team—helping prepare orders, welcoming guests, and keeping the bakery running smoothly. Every shift is different, but one thing never changes: our commitment to delivering warm cookies and exceptional hospitality.

If you enjoy driving, meeting new people, and working with an energetic team, we'd love to meet you.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

Every shift is a mix of driving, hospitality, and teamwork. You'll:

  • Deliver Insomnia Cookies orders safely, accurately, and with a smile.
  • Ensure every order arrives warm, complete, and ready to impress.
  • Navigate efficiently using GPS and delivery technology while following safe driving practices.
  • Welcome guests in the bakery and provide friendly service between deliveries.
  • Assist with preparing, packaging, and organizing delivery and pickup orders.
  • Help bake and package cookies and other treats as needed.
  • Operate the register and process guest transactions.
  • Keep the bakery clean, organized, stocked, and food-safe.
  • Work closely with your bakery team to keep orders moving quickly and accurately.
  • Help create the kind of guest experience that keeps people coming back.

QUALIFICATIONS
  • Must be 18 years of age or older
  • Valid driver's license with a safe driving record.
  • Access to a reliable, insured vehicle that meets company requirements.
  • Current auto insurance that meets state minimum requirements.
  • Smartphone capable of running company delivery applications.
  • Availability to work evenings, nights, weekends, and holidays.

    •  Physical Requirements

    This position regularly requires the ability to:

  • Drive safely for extended periods throughout a shift.
  • Frequently enter and exit a vehicle.
  • Stand and walk for extended periods while working inside the bakery.
  • Lift, carry, and transport orders weighing up to 30 pounds.
  • Occasionally lift up to 50 pounds with assistance.
  • Reach, bend, twist, kneel, and carry bakery products.
  • Work in varying weather conditions while making deliveries.
  • Work around ovens, refrigeration equipment, and moderate bakery noise levels.
  • Communicate effectively with guests, coworkers, and leadership.

    • Work Environment

    You'll split your time between our bakery and the road.

    Inside the bakery, you'll work in a fast-paced environment with ovens, refrigeration equipment, cleaning chemicals, and moderate noise levels. Outside the bakery, you'll drive in varying weather and traffic conditions while following all safety policies and traffic laws.

    Schedule Expectations

    Our busiest times are evenings, late nights, weekends, and holidays. Delivery Drivers should have availability during these peak business hours. Scheduling needs vary by location.

lists.content:
At Insomnia Cookies, our Shift Leaders are the leaders in action. As the person leading the shift, you'll work side-by-side with your Cookie Crew to deliver warm, delicious cookies and an exceptional guest experience. From baking and packing orders to coaching teammates and keeping the bakery running smoothly, you'll lead by example every shift.

If you enjoy fast-paced environments, love working with people, and aren't afraid to roll up your sleeves, this is the role for you.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

As the leader on duty, you will:

  • Lead bakery operations during your shift, ensuring an exceptional guest experience from start to finish.
  • Bake, package, and prepare orders while providing exceptional guest service.
  • Coach and motivate Cookie Crew members, providing direction, feedback, and support throughout the shift.
  • Prioritize and delegate tasks to keep operations running efficiently and meet guest demand.
  • Help maintain our standards for product quality, food safety, cleanliness, and speed of service.
  • Handle cash management, register accountability, and deposits.
  • Communicate important updates and partner with store leadership to keep the bakery operating at its best.
  • Jump in wherever needed to help your team succeed.

QUALIFICATIONS
  • 1+ year of experience in retail, restaurant, hospitality, or another customer-focused environment
  • Strong communication, organization, and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment
  • Positive attitude with a passion for delivering exceptional guest experiences
  • Must be 18 years of age or older
  • Ability to obtain any required food safety certifications applicable to the location
  • Ability to perform the essential functions of the position with or without reasonable accommodation.

    • Physical Requirements

    This position regularly requires the ability to:

  • Stand and walk for extended periods of time (up to 8 hours per shift).
  • Frequently reach, bend, stoop, twist, kneel, and lift.
  • Lift, carry, push, and pull up to 30 pounds regularly.
  • Occasionally lift up to 50 pounds with assistance.
  • Use hands and fingers to handle bakery equipment, food products, and a point-of-sale system.
  • Work in environments with varying temperatures, including around ovens, freezers, and refrigeration units.
  • Safely operate kitchen equipment in accordance with company procedures.
  • Read order screens, recipes, and safety information.
  • Communicate effectively with guests and team members in a fast-paced environment.

    • Work Environment

    This position works in a fast-paced bakery environment that includes frequent interaction with guests, exposure to heat from ovens, refrigerated storage areas, cleaning chemicals, and moderate noise levels. Evening, late-night, weekend, and holiday shifts are a regular part of the business.

    Schedule Expectations

    Our bakeries are busiest during evenings, late nights, weekends, and holidays. Team Members should have availability during these peak business hours. Scheduling needs vary by location.
